description:
Chasing the Mini-Hunter Supreme trophy/achievement? For some reason, Pragmata makes it pretty easy to find and track the hidden collectibles throughout all of the sectors in the game, except for when it comes to one particular collectible type - the Mini Cabin Figurines. For whatever reason, these are not tracked as part of the percentage markers on the map screen and they don’t show up through Diana’s scans, so they’re a bit easier to miss. That’s why we’re here with this video to show you exactly where each and every Mini Cabin figurine is in Pragmata.

description:
IGN's Alan Knight and Nick Limon jump into the world of Tides of Tomorrow, a new asynchronous multiplayer game from Digixart - the creators of Road 96.

Connected through time via the “Story Link” mechanic, Alan's choices directly affect Nick's options for survival in this flooded plasticpunk world. Will Nick follow a similar path to Alan, or seek to undo those decisions and create his own path? Story Links connect you to a member of the dev team, a friend, your favorite streamer, or a stranger – which means each run is somewhat unpredictable.

Jump in and make your own decisions in Tides of Tomorrow, available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X & S, and PC.

Presented by THQ Nordic.
title: IGN Plays: Tides of Tomorrow

description: The world’s worst kept secret has finally come to light. Ubisoft’s Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Remake is here and it’s real. author: IGN
description:
Saros reviewed by Michael Higham on PlayStation 5.

With Saros, Housemarque once again proved that its bullet-hell sensibilities mesh incredibly well with fluid and super-challenging action. This is primarily a test of skill that's as much a rhythmic dance as it is a fireworks show with a punch-packing sci-fi arsenal. The roguelite structure doesn't always work in its favor as it struggles to balance the repetition that’s a natural part of the genre with a strong sense of progression – although going through the motions was still fine, because at least I could sharpen my skills for some sick boss fights that were as difficult as they were fun. I'm left conflicted after the 22 hours I put into seeing it all the way through to its true ending, though. There's a bigger emphasis on story this time around, and it's more ambitious in some respects, which I can appreciate – but when its strongest ideas are a bit too abstracted, powerful themes can end up ringing hollow. So while it's eclipse
title: Saros Review

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Star City, a new sci-fi series distributed by Apple TV+. Embark on a thrilling retelling of history in Star City, streaming on May 29 exclusively on Apple TV+.

A bold new chapter inspired by the critically acclaimed space-race drama, “For All Mankind,” “Star City” is a propulsive paranoid thriller that takes us back to the key moment in the alt-history retelling of the space race — when the Soviet Union became the first nation to put a man on the moon. But this time, we explore the story from behind the Iron Curtain, showing the lives of the cosmonauts, the engineers and the intelligence officers embedded among them in the Soviet space program, and the risks they all took to propel humankind forward.

Star City stars Rhys Ifans, Anna Maxwell Martin, Agnes O’Casey, Alice Englert, Solly McLeod, Adam Nagaitis, Ruby Ashbourne Serkis, Josef Davies, Priya Kansara, and more. The series is executive-produced by Ben Nedivi, Matt Wolpert, Ronald D. Moore
title: Star City - Official Trailer
